fields.statement: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj packs argentsea-logo.png into the NuGet package root via a None item with Pack=true and PackagePath="\"; this project file declares no readme.md (or any other readme) item, so this file configures no packaged readme for the NuGet package.
fields.scope: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql.csproj packaging ItemGroup: the icon item and the absence of a readme item declared in this file.

sources.label: Full file: the cited ItemGroup (21-26) establishes the icon packaging item, and the whole-file read establishes no readme item is declared anywhere in the file
